quotes.quote: In this study, the leukemia microarray gene data, contenting 22283 genes, was extracted from the Gene Expression Omnibus repository.
Data from 36 cases containing 22283 gene expression of AML microarray experiments were retrieved from the GSE9476 dataset, including 10 healthy and 26 AML cases.
A simple neural network with a middle layer has an accuracy of 0.6333, and a deep learning network with three hidden layers has an accuracy of 0.9667

G1.rationale: The principal result (classification accuracy) is produced by training neural networks on the public GSE9476 microarray dataset, which a third party can re-run.

quotes.quote: The results accuracy for single-layer neural network and DNNs deep learning network with three hidden layers are 63.33 and 96.67,
A simple neural network with a middle layer has an accuracy of 0.6333, and a deep learning network with three hidden layers has an accuracy of 0.9667

G2.rationale: The paper's stated principal quantitative result is the classification accuracy of the deep learning network (and the comparison simple network), reported as 0.9667 (96.67%) and 0.6333 (63.33%).

quotes.quote: Data from 36 cases containing 22283 gene expression of AML microarray experiments were retrieved from the GSE9476 dataset, including 10 healthy and 26 AML cases.
The dataset was registered in 2007 and updated in 2017.

G3.rationale: The deposit listing shows only GSE9476_RAW.tar and filelist.txt; it is not possible to confirm from the listing alone that these files are the raw/minimally processed analysis inputs rather than processed outputs.

quotes.quote: Normalized data modeled by TensorFlow, Pandas, Numpy, Sklearn packages, and activity functions include Softmax, Adamax, and RELU.
Also, 70% of data was used as training data, and the number of epochs was considered 1000.

G4.rationale: The paper describes the architecture (three hidden layers), optimizer (Adamax), loss (sparse categorical), activation (ReLU/Softmax), 70% training split and 1000 epochs, but omits layer sizes, learning rate, batch size, dropout rate, random seeds and exact preprocessing steps, so full reimplementation is not guaranteed.

quotes.quote: TensorFlow is an open-source library for large-scale numerical computing and machine learning techniques, making it easier and faster to apply machine learning and deep learning techniques.
Pandas provides fast, flexible and illustrative data structures in Python.

G5.rationale: The method uses only open-source Python packages (TensorFlow, Pandas, Numpy, Sklearn); no proprietary software is required.

specification.exact_target: Classification accuracy of the deep learning network with three hidden layers on the AML microarray dataset, reported as 0.9667 (96.67%), compared with a simple neural network accuracy of 0.6333 (63.33%).
specification.blind_target: Classification accuracy of a deep learning neural network with three hidden layers applied to the AML microarray dataset, compared with a simple neural network.
specification.target_location: Results section, text reporting the simple neural network and deep learning network implementation (also stated in the Abstract).

method_quotes.quote: Normalized data modeled by TensorFlow, Pandas, Numpy, Sklearn packages, and activity functions include Softmax, Adamax, and RELU.

specification.input_notes: GSE9476 dataset registered 2007, updated 2017; 36 samples (10 healthy, 26 AML) with 22283 gene expression features. The deposit listing provides GSE9476_RAW.tar and filelist.txt; filelist.txt is a manifest and not an analysis input.

leakage_files.name: filelist.txt

specification.comparison_metric: Reported classification accuracy (proportion of correctly classified samples) on the AML dataset.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: accuracy must match the reported value within the displayed rounding bin (0.9667 and 0.6333, or 96.67% and 63.33%).
specification.specification_gaps: Number of neurons per hidden layer, learning rate, batch size, dropout rate, random seeds, exact normalization method, exact train/test split indices, and whether accuracy is on training or held-out data are not specified.
